text.p: Here are the main headlines from Lithuania's M-1 Plus radio station's noon news report on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Negotiations between Lithuania and Latvia over the division of flight zones over the Baltic Sea moved forward and most OF the text of an agreement was approved on Monday.
- A member of the opposition Lithuanian Democratic Labour Party Justinas Karosas said his party's term of office improved the economy and Lithuania was no worse off than Estonia.

- The deputy chairman of parliament's foreign affairs committee, Rimantas Dagys, said Estonia has made better progress in its efforts to join the European Union (EU). Lithunia has focused its efforts on joining NATO and has paid too little attention to entering the EU, Dagys said.
